enableCard.title: Guardian Setting
enableCard.description: Controls whether guardian-student linking (bulk assignment, student side-view, and backfill) is available institute-wide. Disabling hides all guardian-linking UI without deleting existing links.

parentPortal.title: Parent Portal
parentPortal.description: Let linked guardians monitor their child's progress, attendance, tests, live classes, fees, and rewards from the learner app. This is separate from guardian linking above — turn it on and choose which sections parents can see.
parentPortal.switchToParentLabel: Student can switch to their parent portal

credentialEmail.title: Guardian Credential Email
credentialEmail.description: Optionally email login credentials whenever a new guardian account is created — whether via bulk assignment, the student side-view's "Add Guardian" action, or a backfill run.
credentialEmail.sendToggleLabel: Send credential email when a guardian account is created
credentialEmail.studentHint: Sends to the student's own email. Recommended for backfill, since a backfilled guardian's email is a placeholder address that can't receive mail.
credentialEmail.guardianHint: Sends to the guardian's own email — meaningful for link/add-guardian flows where a real guardian email was provided; not deliverable for backfilled (placeholder) guardians.

backfillEnrolled.title: Backfill Existing Students
backfillEnrolled.description: Create a guardian account for every enrolled student in this institute that doesn't already have one linked. Students that already have a guardian are skipped and untouched.
backfillEnrolled.emptyState: Every student already has a guardian linked. Nothing to backfill.

backfillLeads.title: Backfill Leads' Guardians
backfillLeads.description: Create a guardian account for every lead in this institute whose student side already has a real account but no guardian linked — reaches leads that haven't been enrolled yet. Leads that already have a guardian are skipped and untouched.
backfillLeads.emptyState: Every lead already has a guardian linked. Nothing to backfill.

backfill.progressLine: {{done}} of {{total}} processed ({{created}} created, {{skipped}} skipped) — running in batches, this may take a while for a large institute.
backfill.completeToast: {{title}} complete: {{created}} created, {{skipped}} skipped out of {{total}} eligible.

backfillDialog.bodyPrefix: This will create a guardian account for
backfillDialog.bodySuffix_one: in this institute that doesn't already have one linked. Students that already have a guardian are skipped and untouched.
backfillDialog.bodySuffix_other: in this institute that don't already have one linked. Students that already have a guardian are skipped and untouched.

export.title: Export Guardian Credentials
export.description: Download a CSV of every linked guardian's login details (one row per guardian, with their linked students). Useful for distributing parent-portal logins in bulk — especially for backfilled guardians, whose placeholder email address can't receive the credential email.
export.warning: This file contains plaintext passwords. Handle and share it carefully.

credentialTemplate.label: Credential Email Template
credentialTemplate.generateTitle: Generate a sample guardian credential email template with placeholders pre-filled
credentialTemplate.placeholder: No template selected — credential emails are skipped until one is chosen
credentialTemplate.updateErrorToast: Failed to update guardian credential email template
credentialTemplate.createErrorToast: Failed to generate sample template. Please try again.
